resources.string: Lets AlertPower act as your power button through the alert slider: turn the screen off, open the power menu, restart the phone, and handle the accessibility button and its own floating button. It only looks at the power menu while a restart you requested is in progress. Otherwise it only notes the name of the app in front, so it can turn itself off for payment apps, and never reads screen content.
Screen off: move the slider to wake. Screen on: flick and return to turn off
Paused for %1$s. Slider wake still works. Tap Pay mode to resume.
